title: GDBus-DBusMenu-Proxy does not work for GTK Wayland apps
line: Native Wayland GTK apps now show their menus in the Global Menu widget and the title bar menu button, like they already did under XWayland.
explanation: GTK applications export their menus as a GMenu on D-Bus and tell the compositor where it is only through GTK's own gtk_shell1 protocol (gtk_surface1.set_dbus_properties). KWin didn't implement gtk_shell1, and the only GMenu-to-DBusMenu converter (gmenudbusmenuproxy, now a kded-x11 module that only lives while Xwayland runs) reads that address from X11 window properties, so native Wayland GTK windows never got a global menu. KWin now advertises gtk_shell1 (version 1, only the D-Bus properties are used) and, while the global menu is in use, registers each GTK window's menu address with the appmenu kded module, which converts it with the proxy's existing code (moved into a shared static library) and hands the DBusMenu address back to KWin for the window. KWin also sends GTK the global_menu_bar capability at the same time, so GTK hides its in-window menu bar exactly when the menu is shown elsewhere, as on X11.

commits.message:
wayland: Implement gtk_shell1 so GTK menus reach the global menu

Native Wayland GTK windows only announce their D-Bus menus through
gtk_shell1, which KWin didn't implement, so the global menu stayed
empty. Implement its D-Bus properties and pass them on to appmenu.

BUG: 424485

appmenu: Export the menus of GTK Wayland windows

The GMenu to DBusMenu conversion only ran in the kded-x11 proxy, so only
X11 windows got one. Share that code in a static library and let appmenu
convert the menus that KWin registers for GTK Wayland windows too.

BUG: 424485

+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "gtkmenuproxy.h"
+
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+
+#include "../gmenu-dbusmenu-proxy/window.h"
+
+static const QString s_serviceName = QStringLiteral("org.kde.GtkMenuProxy");
+static const QString s_objectPath = QStringLiteral("/GtkMenuProxy");
+
+GtkMenuProxy::GtkMenuProxy(QObject *parent)
+    : QObject(parent)
+{
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().registerObject(s_objectPath, this, QDBusConnection::ExportScriptableSlots | QDBusConnection::ExportScriptableSignals);
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().registerService(s_serviceName);
+}
+
+GtkMenuProxy::~GtkMenuProxy()
+{
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().unregisterService(s_serviceName);
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().unregisterObject(s_objectPath);
+    qDeleteAll(m_windows);
+}
+
+void GtkMenuProxy::RegisterWindow(const QString &windowId,
+                                  const QString &serviceName,
+                                  const QString &applicationObjectPath,
+                                  const QString &windowObjectPath,
+                                  const QString &applicationMenuObjectPath,
+                                  const QString &menuBarObjectPath)
+{
+    delete m_windows.take(windowId);
+
+    if (serviceName.isEmpty() || (applicationMenuObjectPath.isEmpty() && menuBarObjectPath.isEmpty())) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    auto *window = new Window(serviceName);
+    window->setApplicationObjectPath(applicationObjectPath);
+    window->setWindowObjectPath(windowObjectPath);
+    window->setApplicationMenuObjectPath(applicationMenuObjectPath);
+    window->setMenuBarObjectPath(menuBarObjectPath);
+    m_windows.insert(windowId, window);
+
+    connect(window, &Window::requestWriteWindowProperties, this, [this, windowId, window] {
+        Q_EMIT WindowMenuChanged(windowId, QDBusConnection::sessionBus().baseService(), window->proxyObjectPath());
+    });
+    connect(window, &Window::requestRemoveWindowProperties, this, [this, windowId] {
+        Q_EMIT WindowMenuChanged(windowId, QString(), QString());
+    });
+
+    window->init();
+}
+
+void GtkMenuProxy::UnregisterWindow(const QString &windowId)
+{
+    delete m_windows.take(windowId);
+}
+
+#include "moc_gtkmenuproxy.cpp"

+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
+*/
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <QHash>
+#include <QObject>
+#include <QString>
+
+class Window;
+
+/**
+ * Exports the GMenus of GTK Wayland windows as DBusMenus.
+ *
+ * KWin learns the D-Bus address of a GTK window's menus through gtk_shell1,
+ * registers the window here and gets the address of the DBusMenu back.
+ */
+class GtkMenuProxy : public QObject
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    Q_CLASSINFO("D-Bus Interface", "org.kde.GtkMenuProxy")
+
+public:
+    explicit GtkMenuProxy(QObject *parent = nullptr);
+    ~GtkMenuProxy() override;
+
+public Q_SLOTS:
+    Q_SCRIPTABLE void RegisterWindow(const QString &windowId,
+                                     const QString &serviceName,
+                                     const QString &applicationObjectPath,
+                                     const QString &windowObjectPath,
+                                     const QString &applicationMenuObjectPath,
+                                     const QString &menuBarObjectPath);
+    Q_SCRIPTABLE void UnregisterWindow(const QString &windowId);
+
+Q_SIGNALS:
+    Q_SCRIPTABLE void WindowMenuChanged(const QString &windowId, const QString &serviceName, const QString &objectPath);
+
+private:
+    QHash<QString, Window *> m_windows;
+};

media.caption: Master: native Wayland GTK3 app with a File/View menubar and a Global Menu widget in the panel; the menus stay in the window and the panel's Global Menu is empty
With the fix: the window's menubar is gone and File, View (and Search) appear in the panel's Global Menu
Zoom of the window and the panel on master
Zoom of the window and the panel with the fix

review.text: Pragmatic, well-structured two-repo solution that finally brings native Wayland GTK3/GTK4 menus to the Global Menu with clean live capability toggling and without breaking XWayland or Qt apps, though KWin maintainers will want to sign off on advertising gtk_shell1 v1 (including the lack of gtk_surface1.release before v4). Before merging, several real lifetime and state bugs in the KWin patch need fixing: client disconnects destroy gtk_surface1 before xdg_toplevel and skip unregisterGtkMenu(), clearing dbus properties leaves stale menu addresses on the window, gtkshell.cpp has a dangling-this connection on surface destruction, and waylandServer()->gtkShell() is dereferenced without a null check.
changes: In kwin/src/xdgshellwindow.cpp, call workspace()->applicationMenu()->unregisterGtkMenu(this) unconditionally in handleRoleDestroyed() (and disconnect any prior m_gtkSurface in installGtkSurface()), because on client disconnect gtk_surface1 is typically destroyed before xdg_toplevel, nulling QPointer m_gtkSurface and leaking entries in both KWin's m_gtkMenus and kded's GtkMenuProxy.

In kwin/src/appmenu.cpp, clear the window's menu (window->setGtkApplicationMenu(QString(), QString())) when unregisterGtkMenu() is called for cleared properties, and null-check waylandServer() and waylandServer()->gtkShell() in setGtkMenuProxyAvailable().

In kwin/src/wayland/gtkshell.cpp, pass q (not gtkSurfaceInterface) as the context receiver for the SurfaceInterface::aboutToBeDestroyed connection so [this] cannot dangle if GtkShellInterface is destroyed first, and guard against duplicate get_gtk_surface requests on the same wl_surface.

In plasma-workspace, order add_subdirectory(gmenu-dbusmenu-proxy) before add_subdirectory(appmenu) in CMakeLists.txt and export ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} in gmenudbusmenuproxy_common's PUBLIC include directories instead of using a relative ../gmenu-dbusmenu-proxy/window.h include.
